reason: A browser-based chat composer utility that provides microphone speech-to-text input with language selection and optional automatic sending.

summaries.zh: 为聊天输入框添加麦克风按钮，使用浏览器语音识别将语音实时转换为文字，并支持语言切换和可选自动发送。
summaries.en: Adds a microphone button to the chat composer for browser-based speech-to-text input with language switching and optional automatic sending.

capabilities: Adds a microphone button to the chat composer
Uses the browser Web Speech API to convert speech to text
Supports Chinese, English, and automatic language selection
Can optionally send recognized text automatically
